name: the same commit with every thread settled is approved
about: A request for changes stood on a commit whose every thread had since been resolved or answered; nothing named held the merge, yet it kept blocking. A verdict lives only while its named reasons do: the review approves, replacing the stale request.

threads.body:
🔴 **Blocking (correctness): Retry loop never ends** (correctness)

The loop retries forever on an empty queue.

🔴 **Blocking (security): Token logged** (security)

The bearer token is written to the log.
